findings.message: data-composition-src references "compositions/b03-1.html", but the file's resolved content has no element with a data-composition-id attribute.
findings.fixHint: Fix this before rendering: the render pre-flight rejects unusable sub-compositions. Write valid HTML into "compositions/b03-1.html". It needs a <template> or <body> containing an element with data-composition-id, data-width, and data-height. Preview/studio still tolerates and skips the scene while you author it. If a scene-authoring step is still running, wait for it to finish before referencing the file, or re-run the step that generates it.
